decisions.reason: The existing same-message Event captures individual inspection, timing, and regeneration but omits the explicit condition that an image may be inserted only when it has no spelling error.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
so it means when you are adding images to ontario drivers license book - you need to check what you added, you cannot just blindly copy-paste it into the word doc. If there are spelling errors, you need to re-generate that image and add it to the MS word file. So it means you are checking the image one by one.

step 1: Generate image -

step 2: Check if it is correct

step 3: If no spelling error, then add it to the MS word file

value_updates.validation_timing: after generation and before insertion into the Word file
value_updates.spelling_error_action: regenerate an image containing a spelling error before inserting it
value_updates.insertion_condition: insert the image into the Word file only if it has no spelling error

decisions.reason: The source instruction specifically governs validation while adding images to the Ontario driver license book and does not change the NASM CPT document, heading level, deliverable, or due date.
Checking generated images for spelling errors before insertion does not alter the requirement to begin image generation from chapter 1.
The Ontario image-validation instruction does not affect the content, length, structure, or formatting rules for the ALEKS review material.
The source concerns generated-image inspection during the image-generation phase, explicitly distinct from proofreading, and does not change the Canada citizenship proofreading task.
